groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control
groups.description: Configuration for WebSocket flow control mechanisms including backpressure, rate limiting, and heartbeat.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure
groups.description: Configuration for WebSocket backpressure handling to manage message overflow scenarios.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure.default-config
groups.description: Default backpressure configuration applied to all WebSocket paths unless overridden.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit
groups.description: Configuration for WebSocket rate limiting to prevent abuse and ensure fair resource usage.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config
groups.description: Default rate limit configuration applied to all WebSocket paths unless overridden.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat
groups.description: Configuration for WebSocket heartbeat (ping/pong) to detect connection health and timeout inactive connections.

groups.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat.default-config
groups.description: Default heartbeat configuration applied to all WebSocket paths unless overridden.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.validation.jsr303.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable JSR-303 validation for WebSocket messages.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable all flow control mechanisms globally.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable backpressure flow control.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure.default-config.strategy
properties.description: Backpressure strategy to apply when buffer is full. BUFFER: Buffer messages up to bufferSize. DROP_OLDEST: Drop oldest messages when full. DROP_LATEST: Drop newest messages when full. ERROR: Emit error when full.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure.default-config.buffer-size
properties.description: Maximum number of messages to buffer when using BUFFER strategy.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.backpressure.paths
properties.description: Path-specific backpressure configurations. Keys should be WebSocket endpoint paths (e.g., '/ws/chat').

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable rate limiting flow control.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config.limit-for-period
properties.description: Maximum number of messages allowed within the refresh period.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config.limit-refresh-period
properties.description: Duration of the rate limit period in the specified time unit.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config.time-unit
properties.description: Time unit for the limit refresh period (NANOSECONDS, MICROSECONDS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, MINUTES, HOURS, DAYS).

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config.timeout
properties.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for permission when rate limit is reached.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.default-config.scope
properties.description: Scope of rate limiting. SESSION: Per WebSocket session. USER: Per authenticated user. IP: Per IP address.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.rate-limit.paths
properties.description: Path-specific rate limit configurations. Keys should be WebSocket endpoint paths (e.g., '/ws/api').

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable heartbeat (ping/pong) flow control.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat.default-config.interval
properties.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeat ping messages.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat.default-config.timeout
properties.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for pong response before considering connection dead.

properties.name: spring.webflux.reactive.websockets.flow-control.heartbeat.paths
properties.description: Path-specific heartbeat configurations. Keys should be WebSocket endpoint paths (e.g., '/ws/realtime').

values.description: Buffer messages up to the specified buffer size.

Drop the newest messages when buffer is full.
Emit an error when buffer is full.
